title: AIIMS Gorakhpur Notification 2026 - Walk-in-Interview for 02 Project Technical Support I Posts
description: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Gorakhpur (AIIMS Gorakhpur) has recently published the official notification for the recruitment of 02 Project Technical Support I Jobs. Candidates who have completed any degree , B.sc Nursing, or B. Sc can use this opportunity and apply for the AIIMS Gorakhpur Notification 2026 .
